items.item_text: One (1) year of clinical laboratory experience including knowledge of instrument operation, specimen processing, knowledge of specimen send-outs, and/or microbiology specimen processing.
Five years of clinical laboratory experience or two years of college preferred

Administrative Duties Performs monitoring and reordering of supplies; orders all special reagents/solutions and equipment necessary to develop new procedures. Answers telephone inquiries regarding pathology matters and takes appropriate action.
Performs monitoring and reordering of supplies; orders all special reagents/solutions and equipment necessary to develop new procedures.
Answers telephone inquiries regarding pathology matters and takes appropriate action.

Specimen Processing Verification of corresponding patient information on requisitions and specimen containers; picks up and delivers specimens from clinical laboratory or other areas to pathology laboratory as needed; assign appropriate specimen number according to type of specimen and enter accurate information in computer; properly labels requisitions, specimen containers and cassettes with assigned specimen number. Records descriptive identification, weight and instruments of gross specimens on requisition and in computer.

Quality Control and Maintenance Maintains clean work area and instruments. Prepares and provides fixative solutions and containers to other departments upon request (i.e. surgery, endoscopy).

General typing/computer skills Must demonstrate excellent communication and customer service skills
